text.card: A red giant 3,714 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.93 solar masses and 8.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,828 K at its surface.
